properties.name: AutoScroll
properties.description: Shows scroll bars when the content is larger than the panel.
properties.usage: Host a form that is bigger than the available space.
properties.expectedEffect: Scroll bars appear when child controls extend past the edges.

properties.name: BorderStyle
properties.description: The border drawn around the panel.
properties.usage: Make the boundary of a group visible.
properties.expectedEffect: A thin line surrounds the panel.

properties.name: AutoSize
properties.description: Makes the panel grow to fit its child controls. AutoSizeMode decides whether it can also shrink.
properties.usage: Let a panel follow dynamically added content.
properties.expectedEffect: The panel resizes when controls are added or removed.

properties.name: FlatStyle
properties.description: Selects how the frame and caption are drawn.
properties.usage: Use System for the native Windows look.
properties.expectedEffect: The frame is drawn by the operating system.

properties.name: AutoSize
properties.description: Makes the group box grow to fit its child controls.
properties.usage: Let the frame follow its content.
properties.expectedEffect: The group box resizes around its controls.

properties.name: TabPages
properties.description: The pages of the control.
properties.usage: Create a page from code.
properties.expectedEffect: A new tab appears at the end of the tab strip.

properties.name: SelectedIndex
properties.defaultValue: 0 once a page exists (-1 if there is none)
properties.acceptedValues: -1 or an index of an existing page
properties.description: Zero-based index of the visible page.
properties.usage: Open a specific page.
properties.expectedEffect: The second page becomes visible.

properties.name: SelectedTab
properties.description: The visible page itself.
properties.usage: Switch to a page by reference.
properties.expectedEffect: The Advanced page is shown.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: The side of the control where the tabs appear.
properties.usage: Put tabs on the left for a vertical navigation.
properties.expectedEffect: The tab strip moves to the left edge.

properties.name: Multiline
properties.description: Lets the tabs wrap onto several rows instead of scrolling.
properties.usage: Show all tabs at once when there are many.
properties.expectedEffect: Tabs wrap to additional rows.

properties.name: ImageList
properties.description: The icons that pages can use through ImageIndex.
properties.usage: Add icons to the tabs.
properties.expectedEffect: Pages with an ImageIndex show their icon.

properties.name: ImageIndex
properties.acceptedValues: -1 or a valid index of the TabControl.ImageList
properties.description: The icon of the tab.
properties.usage: Show an icon on the tab header.
properties.expectedEffect: The first image of the ImageList appears on the tab.

properties.name: UseVisualStyleBackColor
properties.defaultValue: false in code (the designer sets true)
properties.description: When true, the page is drawn with the themed background and BackColor is ignored.
properties.usage: Set it to false before changing BackColor.
properties.expectedEffect: The page now honors BackColor.

properties.name: ToolTipText
properties.description: The tip shown when the pointer is over the tab. The TabControl must have ShowToolTips set to true.
properties.usage: Explain what a tab contains.
properties.expectedEffect: A tip appears over the tab header.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Direction of the splitter. Vertical puts the panels side by side.
properties.usage: Stack the panels on top of each other with Horizontal.
properties.expectedEffect: Panel1 appears above Panel2.

properties.name: SplitterDistance
properties.acceptedValues: Between Panel1MinSize and the container size minus Panel2MinSize and SplitterWidth
properties.description: Distance in pixels from the left (or top) edge to the splitter.
properties.usage: Set the initial width of a navigation pane.
properties.expectedEffect: The splitter moves to 250 px.

properties.name: SplitterWidth
properties.description: The thickness of the splitter bar.
properties.usage: Make the bar easier to grab.
properties.expectedEffect: The bar becomes thicker.

properties.name: FixedPanel
properties.description: The panel that keeps its size when the container is resized.
properties.usage: Keep a sidebar at a constant width.
properties.expectedEffect: Only Panel2 grows or shrinks on resize.

properties.name: Panel1
properties.description: The first panel (left or top).
properties.usage: Add controls to the first panel.
properties.expectedEffect: The control is hosted in the first panel.

properties.name: Panel2
properties.description: The second panel (right or bottom).
properties.usage: Add controls to the second panel.
properties.expectedEffect: The control is hosted in the second panel.

properties.name: IsSplitterFixed
properties.description: Prevents the user from dragging the splitter. Code can still move it.
properties.usage: Lock a layout.
properties.expectedEffect: The splitter can no longer be dragged.

properties.name: Panel1Collapsed
properties.description: Hides the first panel so the second one uses all the space.
properties.usage: Toggle a sidebar.
properties.expectedEffect: Panel1 disappears and Panel2 fills the container.

properties.name: FlowDirection
properties.description: The direction in which child controls are arranged.
properties.usage: Stack controls vertically with TopDown.
properties.expectedEffect: Controls are placed one below the other.

properties.name: WrapContents
properties.description: Whether controls move to a new row or column when the edge is reached.
properties.usage: Keep all controls in one line.
properties.expectedEffect: Controls stay in a single row or column.

properties.name: AutoScroll
properties.description: Shows scroll bars when the content does not fit.
properties.usage: Scroll a long vertical list of controls.
properties.expectedEffect: Scroll bars appear when needed.

properties.name: RowCount
properties.description: The number of rows in the grid.
properties.usage: Define the grid before adding controls.
properties.expectedEffect: The grid has three rows.

properties.name: ColumnCount
properties.description: The number of columns in the grid.
properties.usage: Create a two-column label and input layout.
properties.expectedEffect: The grid has two columns.

properties.name: ColumnStyles
properties.description: The sizing rules of the columns.
properties.usage: Give the second column all the extra space.
properties.expectedEffect: The column grows with the panel.

properties.name: RowStyles
properties.description: The sizing rules of the rows.
properties.usage: Make rows fit their content.
properties.expectedEffect: The row height follows its content.

properties.name: CellBorderStyle
properties.acceptedValues: None, Single, Inset, InsetDouble, Outset, OutsetPartial, OutsetDouble
properties.description: Draws lines between cells.
properties.usage: Show grid lines while designing the layout.
properties.expectedEffect: Thin lines appear between the cells.

properties.name: GrowStyle
properties.description: What happens when a control is added to a full grid.
properties.usage: Allow the grid to add columns instead of rows.
properties.expectedEffect: New columns are created as needed.
